title: Password hashed without KDF
message: Password-like input is passed directly to a hash operation.
remediation: Use a password KDF such as PBKDF2, scrypt, Argon2, or bcrypt.

title: Verification disabled
message: Certificate, hostname or token-signature verification is disabled or implemented as an unconditional success.
remediation: Use the platform trust manager and hostname verifier, and verify token signatures with a restricted key/algorithm set.

title: Insecure transport
message: Data is sent over cleartext HTTP or a deprecated SSL/TLS protocol version is enabled.
remediation: Use HTTPS and require TLS 1.2 or newer.

title: Weak hash
message: A deprecated hash algorithm is used in a security-sensitive context.
remediation: Use SHA-256 or a stronger approved hash for security-sensitive hashing.
